H1.question: Full FrameLease achieves a higher DS than each of Fixed Deep, Fast Only, Age-Only and Event-Triggered at kappa 1.0 on the 44 test routes (Holm over 4)
H1.rule: each contrast: improves if the mean DS difference is > 0 with Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 (Holm over 4), worse if < 0 with Holm-adjusted p < 0.05, otherwise inconclusive; finding 1 may be stated only if contrasts 1 and 2 are both improves, finding 2 only if contrasts 3 and 4 are both improves; mixed outcomes are reported as mixed (Sec. 9.2)

H2.question: key secondary: Full FrameLease achieves a higher DS than FrameLease + Heuristic (single test)
H2.rule: the RL benefit is claimed only if H2 is improves; with P_both < 0.05 in the kappa-1.0 episodes of the RL dataset the RL contribution is labelled "not testable at this operating point" and H2 is reported with that label (Secs. 5.8, 9.13)
